acceptance: Free disk is above the floor with headroom; stale merged worktrees are removed under an owner-approved rule; make pr-preflight runs without an override.
context:
2026-11-01 ~19:30Z: free disk fell to about 26 GiB; #3827's preflight ran with BENCHBOX_HEAVY_MIN_FREE_DISK_GIB=20 and its tail showed the machine stopping, not a pass line. Urgency rising.

2026-11-02: owner approved `make worktree-reap APPLY=1` on 2026-11-01 (choice dialog, session 01a19729). It removed 113 worktrees whose PR merged with HEAD at the merged head, clean and nothing unpushed (dry run: 116 remove, 45 keep, 113 ambiguous untouched). The space returned once the Time Machine local snapshot taken before the reap expired: free disk went from 15 GiB to 531 GiB and heavy-work admission is ADMITTED at the 50 GiB floor. The uv cache was not pruned. Ambiguous worktrees remain for an owner-approved rule.
description: On 2026-11-01 the Mac had about 40 GiB free against the 50 GiB BENCHBOX_HEAVY_MIN_FREE_DISK_GIB floor, so make pr-preflight refused heavy work (exit 76). Three PRs ran preflight once with the floor lowered to 35, and #3899 merged without a clean preflight exit. The host has about 256 linked worktrees and a 31 GiB uv cache; uv cache prune was blocked by running uv processes. Owner-approved cleanup of merged-branch worktrees and caches is needed.
